svg.title: Constraint resonance (Fuckari)
svg.desc: A loop of three stages. Emergent structure forms a new higher-level constraint regime; that regime reshapes the lower-level interaction space; the reshaped space yields further emergent structure, and the loop runs again, each turn depending on the path before it.
